title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Calendar Rule: Counting Removal Grace Days by Transport Type
content:
**Calendar rule.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking, which days count as removal grace days follows the transport the vehicle needs:

- for a vehicle with high-voltage damage recorded on the booking that arrived on a network-arranged tow, only **Monday to Friday** count as grace days and Saturdays and Sundays are passed over, because high-voltage carriers move vehicles on business days only;
- for a vehicle without high-voltage damage that arrived on a network-arranged tow, **Monday to Saturday** count and Sundays are passed over;
- for every other vehicle every calendar day counts.

The grace days are counted forward from the responsibility date, which is not itself counted. The grace period runs from the day after the responsibility date through the day on which the last grace day is counted, any passed-over days inside it included.

| High-voltage damage recorded | Tow-in charge posted on the booking | Days that count |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Monday to Friday |
| No | Yes | Monday to Saturday |
| Either | No | Every calendar day |

**Day charts** (hypothetical responsibility dates)

| Calendar | Grace days | Responsibility date | Days counted | Grace period ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday to Friday | 3 | Thursday | Friday (1), Saturday and Sunday passed over, Monday (2), Tuesday (3) | Tuesday |
| Monday to Friday | 2 | Friday | Saturday and Sunday passed over, Monday (1), Tuesday (2) | Tuesday |
| Monday to Saturday | 3 | Friday | Saturday (1), Sunday passed over, Monday (2), Tuesday (3) | Tuesday |
| Monday to Saturday | 2 | Saturday | Sunday passed over, Monday (1), Tuesday (2) | Tuesday |
| Every calendar day | 3 | Friday | Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3) | Monday |
